rdfs:label: unionOf
rdfs:comment: OWL class expression: defines a class as the union of a list of other classes — instances of the new class are instances of any one of the listed classes.
notes: Logical OR across classes. Common use: declaring `rdfs:domain` or `rdfs:range` for a property that accepts multiple types — "this property's value is a Person OR an Organization." Value is an `rdf:List` of class IRIs or class expressions.

examples.title: Range accepting a Person or an Organization

history.note: Example uses an example.org property with a typed owl:Class union range instead of redefining as:actor's domain.
